svg.title: What decides whether a gated climb climbs
svg.desc: Simulated 5-round climbs using the measured noise (run-to-run sd 21.0, item-by-config sd 13.1) and the measured spread of the teacher's proposals (1.7). When the average proposal is worse than the incumbent, the real gain stays near zero for both 120 and 480 dev puzzles, and fewer than 9 in 100 climbs accept a step that is really a loss. Measured average steps: full rewrites -4.5, one-rule edits -1.3, adding a calculation tool +17.0.

g.text: how much better the teacher's average proposal really is (points)
whatever the size of the dev set
